issues.quote: what weighs is that every time it demands attention, that I am no longer master of it, it is master of me
In fact you become the slave of this many-headed beast.
I cannot get out of a man's way.
you who through the windows of houses, thousands of black mouths, forever breathe out your stench
in all your variety of colors and forms

strengths.quote: I confess I envy the planets: they have their orbits, and nothing stands in their path.
like air through windows and doors, like the waters of tributaries into a river
You flog the holy silence of the earth with the grinding of factories and the thunder of wheels
You toss into my heart, as into your own storeroom, your sufferings and your pains
If only for a while I could free myself of it, forget, rest. I am tired.
